mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near City Hall and a bright full moon to look forward to tonight. You can expect temperatures to drop to an overnight low of 53 degrees, with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has announced that the Plan Commission will meet on November 4th at 6:30 PM to review site plans for projects like the Ardent Glen third addition and new developments on Milky Way. Also, keep an eye on your mailbox as property tax bills will be sent out no later than December 15th.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join trivia nights starting next week at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, Paddy Mac's, and The Bogey Factory.

On October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. The department confirmed no injuries occurred and they are currently reviewing the incident.
Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for today's flavor of the day.
